messages:
kyle: quick check before the EU infra rollover tonight — are we covered for TLS downgrade protections? also who is owning the key rotation handoff for the new region? need logging redaction confirmation too (no private key blobs in logs).
mahir: i own the CMK for eu-prod in AWS KMS. rotation schedule is in the runbook. for downgrade: public LB enforces TLS1.3 only, internal LB still allows TLS1.2 for legacy clients. we plan to disable TLS1.2 after the rotation window.
ops-jen: confirming: public LB ciphers locked to TLS1.3 + AEAD. internal paths will keep TLS1.2 for a tiny fleet during the roll. we have mTLS between services so risk is low. i'll coordinate the disable next week and do a canary first. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tls-rotation
anya: on logs — we strip handshake blobs at ingest. parser removes PEMs/privkey blobs and stores only Subject, Issuer, and fingerprint. i ran a grep earlier; no '-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----' in the index. cc @sec-bot for audit scan.
sec-bot: automated scan result: tls-log-scan v2.1 — 0 matches for PEM/privkey patterns in last 90d. report id rpt-18456789 (https://internal.redwood/reports/rpt-18456789).
mahir: rotation handoff checklist: 1) me rotate CMK, 2) ops-jen update LB cert alias, 3) infra coordinate deploy + rollback. i'm available 23:00 UTC. need explicit approval from oncall and security.
kyle: approving 23:00 UTC window. @sre-chris please confirm ops availability and rollback plan.
sre-chris: oncall available. rollback plan: keep previous cert alias for 1 hour, if errors revert LB and rotate alias back. will monitor latency and error rates. add 30m maintenance window on status page.
ops-jen: will add maintenance window and push cert update. note: disabling TLS1.2 happens after cert swap on canary. will execute smoke checks: curl /health, curl /v1/predict, websocket handshake. will report failures in this thread.
kyle: one more: are we enabling TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV on the LB libs to prevent fallback attacks?
mahir: yes — TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV set on nginx 1.22 build. ran a negative test with openssl s_client fallback attempt; connection rejected for downgrade attempt.
anya: sounds good. i'll post a brief note to #incidents if any client regressions show up. otherwise :thumbsup:
